summary: Frontend-only retest (iteration 7) of the 4 fixes from iteration_6 on the social-media rewrite. All 4 targeted fixes VERIFIED GREEN via Playwright on the public preview URL: (1) frohlich-mark.png is now byte-identical to frohlich-logo.png (md5 7c8ed3f2..., 1398201 bytes) and renders as real logo (naturalWidth 1838x856) in IG header/story-ring/post-header/company-reply; clicking the avatar opens SocialProfilePhotoPreview showing the real logo — no 'Supabase ist im Build nicht konfiguriert' text anywhere. (2) IG post modal + 'Alle N Kommentare anzeigen' expand renders 10 comment rows, 21 placeholder.svg avatars, 0 broken images (naturalWidth===0), 0 refs to the deleted /assets/social/instagram/avatars path. (3) Facebook Info tab and LinkedIn Info tab now show only kontakt@froehlich-vermoegensberatung.de; 0 'kapitalmitte' occurrences in the runtime text of all 3 social modals. (4) IG Reels tab: 3 reels, reel viewer opens with video src=null + poster=/assets/social/placeholder.svg, video.error===null, no media console errors. Regression: /, /news, /login load with 0 local broken images and 0 uncaught JS errors. NEW FINDING: the email sweep was incomplete — 63 hardcoded occurrences of kundenservice@kapitalmitte.com remain in 33 src files (FAQ page shows it user-visibly, plus all contract forms, PDF generators, AuthContext error strings, AdminContractSubmissions).

ui_bugs.component: FAQ page / contract forms / PDF generators / AuthContext
ui_bugs.issue: Email sweep incomplete: 63 hardcoded 'kundenservice@kapitalmitte.com' strings in 33 files. /faq renders it visibly (2x) next to the new kontakt@froehlich-vermoegensberatung.de -> two conflicting support addresses. Affected: pages/FAQ.js, all *ContractForm/*Vertrag pages, lib/generate*Pdf.js, context/AuthContext.js (2 user-facing error strings), pages/AdminContractSubmissions.js, components/liveness/IdentityInterviewFlow.jsx, pages/Login.js, pages/Register.js. Should import siteContact.email instead of hardcoding.

Still present from iteration_6: the truncated-bio 'mehr' toggle sits flush against/overlaps the 'Website folgt' link on the same line (see ig_open screenshot) — no gap, looks like one broken token 'mehr<> Website folgt'.
Still no data-testid on the 3 platform trigger buttons (only aria-label). Tests must rely on aria-label text.
Cosmetic: post media is the 4:5 placeholder.svg letterboxed on a black background, producing large black bars above/below the image inside the modal.

issues: Console SVG error x4 on every home load: '<path> attribute d: Expected moveto path command (M or m), "undefined"' — an icon component is rendering an undefined path string (bundle.js:165522).
Supabase edge function /functions/v1/stock-history returns 401 repeatedly (~12x per load); handled gracefully by stockHistoryService (debug 'skipped') but floods console with errors.

Third-party bank logos hotlinked from images.seeklogo.com / cdn-group.bnpparibas.com / bbva.de are blocked (ERR_BLOCKED_BY_RESPONSE.NotSameOrigin / ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ORB); local fallbacks render so no visible broken images, but the remote requests should be dropped.
Cover photo uses the same generic FV placeholder as the avatar, so cover and profile picture look duplicated (cosmetic, expected until real assets exist).

action_items: Replace the remaining 63 hardcoded 'kundenservice@kapitalmitte.com' strings (33 files) with siteContact.email — /faq is user-visible; contract PDFs and auth error messages also affected.
Fix the Instagram bio 'mehr' / 'Website folgt' spacing overlap (carry-over MEDIUM from iteration_6).
Add data-testid to SocialFooterIcons platform buttons and to IG grid/reel tiles + 'Alle N Kommentare anzeigen' toggle for stable automation.
Investigate the '<path> d=undefined' SVG console error on home (undefined icon path prop).
critical_code_review_comments: frohlich-mark.png is now a 1.37 MB full-logo duplicate used as a 40px avatar in many places — heavy payload for an avatar; a small cropped mark (or width/height-constrained WebP) should be generated.

instagramPostComments.js still exports instagramCommentAvatarFallback() pointing at the deleted /assets/social/instagram/avatars/generated/*.svg path — dead code that would 404 if an onError handler ever fires; remove it.
av() and REEL_AVATAR() ignore their slug argument and return a constant; parameters should be dropped to avoid the impression of per-user avatars.
Email/contact data is duplicated as literals across 33 files instead of importing siteContact — the same class of bug will recur on the next rebrand.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 4 targeted fixes + regressions passed; 1 new HIGH data-consistency issue found outside the social modals

seed_data_creation: None. Cookie/visitor gate bypassed via localStorage keys kapitalmitte_cookie_consent + kapitalmitte_visitor_profile.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 iteration_6 findings are fixed and verified. Working Playwright recipe: set localStorage kapitalmitte_cookie_consent + kapitalmitte_visitor_profile then reload; open modal via page.get_by_role('button', name='Instagram'|'Facebook'|'LinkedIn').first. Inside the IG modal, 'button:has(img[src*="placeholder"])' yields 10 tiles: nth(0..3) are story highlights, nth(4)+ are grid posts — clicking nth(0) opens the story viewer, not a post. Reels tab: 'button[aria-label*="Reel"]', then tiles nth(4) opens the reel viewer. Post comments: page.get_by_text('Kommentare anzeigen') then count page.get_by_label('Profil von'). Remaining open items: hardcoded old email in 33 files (FAQ visible), IG bio 'mehr'/'Website folgt' overlap, missing data-testids, home-page '<path> d=undefined' console error.
rca_of_the_issue: The iteration_6 email sweep only replaced the value inside data/siteContact.js and files that import it; 33 files hardcode the literal 'kundenservice@kapitalmitte.com' (contract templates, PDF generators, auth error strings, FAQ copy) and were not touched, so /faq now displays both the old and new support address simultaneously. Fix by importing siteContact.email in those files rather than another blind sed.
